prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: seamless tileable photorealistic game environment PBR base-color texture, square 2K
Primary request: an original alien-infected landscape tissue surface for Predator Isle, not a scene or concept landscape. Opaque charcoal-grey biomechanical organic skin with irregular interwoven fine fibres, restrained elongated growth wrinkles and broad softly folded biofilm. It must read as tangible weathered biological tissue, not rock, bark, scales, a rope weave or a repeating decorative pattern.

Seamlessly wrapping left/right and top/bottom with no border, no central motif and no obvious repeating cells. Natural variation across several detail scales, mostly quiet smooth leathery tissue broken by subtle connected growth folds.
Lighting: neutral cross-polarized diffuse albedo reference, even flat illumination. No directional lighting, cast shadows, ambient-occlusion pockets, shiny baked highlights, reflections, vignette, depth of field or perspective. This image will be lit by the game engine.
Color palette: restrained neutral-to-cool medium charcoal grey, approximate base-color RGB 65 to 110 of 255 with small low-saturation grey-brown variations; readable fine detail without high-contrast white veins or deep black grooves. No glowing elements or bright colors.
Constraints: one continuous opaque material only, not a normal/height map or a grid of maps. No props, creatures, eyes, faces, organs, gore, architecture, horizon, sky, lava, text, labels, logos or watermark. No large holes, regularly spaced bumps, braided-rope motifs or tiled-looking medallions. Maintain consistent texel scale and realistic nonuniform microtexture.
